Hi, my name is Jayden, and I'm 16 with big dreams! Someday, I want to run my own horse rescue. Currently, we have already rescued and are caring for three beautiful mares, Evergreen, Sparky, and Sage, on our family farm. My biggest goal is to save as many horses as possible and advocate for proper care and respectful treatment. Follow along to watch my dreams unfold ! 


Thank you so much for watching! if you feel led to donate to Spitfire Equine Rescue, please send your donation to 
https://cash.app/$Jaydensheene7090 all donations go towards feeds and medicines, etc, to help care for these horses. I work all the jobs I can, and my mom and I are doing our very best to provide a loving and safe environment for them! 


If you would like to support spitfire.equine.rescue, you can oder off of our Amazon wish list. Thank you so much it really helps out the channel and the horses!!
